'''Health and environment'''
*[[2026 Ebola epidemic]]
**The death toll from the [[Ebola]] epidemic in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] rises to over 1,500 people killed. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-ebola-death-toll-bundibugyo-virus-response-treatment-269eac4d8a93be912459486428ef2f94 (AP)]
**[[Singapore]]-based [[Hilleman Laboratories]] announces plans to advance an [[RVSV-ZEBOV vaccine|rVSV]]-based [[Ebola vaccine|vaccine]] against the [[Bundibugyo ebolavirus|Bundibugyo strain]] of Ebola into [[human trial]]s after [[World Health Organization]] experts identified it as the most promising candidate for the epidemic. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/singapore-ebola-vaccine-hilleman-laboratories-merck-bundibugyo-6288361 (AFP via CNA)]

[https://www.cbsnews.com/detroit/news/michigan-cyclosporiasis-cases-193-hospital-cases-july-30/ (CBS News MI)]
*[[Nuclear power in Hungary]]
**The [[Paks Nuclear Power Plant|Paks nuclear power plant]] in [[Hungary]] shuts down for the first time in 44 years amid a drought across the country and extremely low [[Hydrology of Hungary|water levels]] on the [[Danube]] river. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cn0nqv05g0do (BBC News)] [https://www.dw.com/en/danube-water-levels-hungary-romania-cut-nuclear-output/a-78171891 (DW)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Morocco–Spain relations]]
**[[2026 Morocco–Spain border incident]]
***Thousands of [[undocumented immigrants]] cross into the [[Spain|Spanish]] [[Autonomous communities of Spain|autonomous city]] of [[Ceuta]] from [[Morocco–Spain border|neighboring]] [[Morocco]]. The city's [[Mayor-President of Ceuta|mayor-president]], [[Juan Jesús Vivas]], requests the [[Government of Spain|Spanish government]] to declare a [[state of emergency|national emergency]], but is refused by the [[Ministry of the Interior (Spain)|interior ministry]]. [https://apnews.com/article/spain-ceuta-tarajal-morocco-migrants-5c864e5f951e2a7cf7a3eac417668e97 (AP)]
***Senior [[Italy|Italian]] politicians, including [[Prime Minister of Italy|prime minister]] [[Giorgia Meloni]], deputy prime minister [[Matteo Salvini]], and [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Italy)|foreign minister]] [[Antonio Tajani]], call for Spain to be kicked out of the [[Schengen Zone]] or the suspension of the [[Schengen Agreement]] entirely, citing the alleged threat of undocumented immigrants spreading throughout the [[European Union]]. [https://www.politico.eu/article/migration-crisis-spain-italy-clash-over-schengen-morocco-cueta/ (''Politico EU'')]
*[[Chile–Venezuela relations]]
**[[Chile]] and [[Venezuela]] restore diplomatic relations after a two-year suspension following Chile's call for a review of the [[2024 Venezuelan presidential election]] results. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/07/31/world/chile-and-venezuela-restore-diplomatic-relations/2395619 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]

**[[Naoero]] announces it has withdrawn its recognition of [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]]'s [[breakaway state]]s [[Abkhazia]] and [[South Ossetia]], terminating diplomatic relations with these entities "with immediate effect". [https://civil.ge/archives/746547 (Civil Georgia)]
